summary: Nyxoah SA furnished a Form  .,6-K attaching its October 19, 2026 press release with preliminary unaudited third-quarter 2026 results and revised 2026 revenue guidance. Global net revenue is expected at roughly €9.2 million, up 19% sequentially, with U.S. net revenue of about €6.7 million, up 29% sequentially. Commercial metrics include 80 new surgeons trained (342 total), 53 new accounts activated (233 total), and 447 patients in prior authorization. The release notes ACCCESS pivotal study success in Complete Concentric Collapse patients and a PMA supplement submission to expand the Genio U.S. indication. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine earnings update, not a special situation; watch reimbursement and FDA supplement timing.
